title: [Subcontracting] Bug 647210 & 647791: Enable IT migration in production and keep Legacy Subcontracting on when app install is declined
summary: The Legacy Subcontracting to Subcontracting app migration now works in production environments, and declining the app installation prompt no longer incorrectly disables the legacy feature.
key_points: Removed sandbox-only restriction preventing production environments from migrating to Subcontracting app
Fixed issue where declining app installation still disabled Legacy Subcontracting, leaving data stranded
CheckCanDisableLegacySubcontracting now returns Boolean to properly control whether disabling proceeds
Removed unused System.Environment import and sandbox-related error label
Added test case to verify legacy feature stays enabled when app installation is declined
quote: Disabling Legacy Subcontracting is now permitted in production when migration prerequisites are met.
